title: 第9章  中级变异体
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

就在林夕沉浸在喜悦中时，一旁的一个女生开口说道:“我们去体育活动室吧，剩下的大部分同学都在那里，校长他们也都在哪里。”

女生旁边的一个同学说道：“你是怎么知道的？”

那个女生说道:“我朋友给我发了信息，说是他们那里有3个与孙老师一样的人。”

就在这时林夕猛地将目光看向张常，只见张常面露痛苦的抱着头蹲在了地上。

孙悦想上前询问的时候被林夕拉住了。孙悦投来疑惑的目光

林夕解释道：“他在觉醒能力。”孙悦说道：“可是我并没有这样啊。”

“每个人的能力不同，因人而异。”林夕解释道

孙悦看向林夕说道:“怎么好像你知道很多一样。”林夕讪讪的笑着说道：“比较喜欢看丧尸类的小说。”

孙悦点了点头没有在说什么，突如其来的变故给刚才说话的同学也吓了一跳。

不再说话，静静的坐在那里看着孙悦林夕。

过了大约十分钟左右的时间，张常慢慢的平息了下来。

林夕走上前问道：“怎么样，有没有感觉有什么不一样的地方？”

张常看着林夕说道：“感觉我的力量变强了好多，我现在感觉我一拳能打死一头牛。”张常边说边比划着

林夕笑着说道：“哪有那么夸张，你现在顶多就是比正常人厉害一些罢了。除了力量变强还有什么吗？”

张常摇了摇头说道：“好像没有了。”林夕一惊心里想着：“纯力量觉醒者，很少见啊。系统应该该给任务了吧。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Just when Lin Xi was immersed in joy, a girl on the side said: "Let's go to the sports activity room. Most of the remaining classmates are there, including the principal."

A classmate next to the girl said, "How did you know?"

The girl said: "My friend sent me a message, saying that there are three people like Teacher Sun there."

At this moment, Lin Xi suddenly looked at Zhang Chang and saw Zhang Chang squatting on the ground holding his head in pain.

When Sun Yue wanted to step forward to ask, Lin Xi pulled him back.Sun Yue cast a doubtful look

Lin Xi explained: "He is awakening his ability." Sun Yue said: "But I am not like this."

"Everyone's abilities are different and vary from person to person." Lin Xi explained

Sun Yue looked at Lin Xi and said, "How come you seem to know a lot." Lin Xi smiled and said, "I prefer reading zombie novels."

Sun Yue nodded and said nothing. The sudden change shocked the classmate who just spoke.

He stopped talking and sat there quietly looking at Sun Yue and Lin Xi.

After about ten minutes, Zhang Chang slowly calmed down.

Lin Xi stepped forward and asked, "How are you doing? Do you feel anything different?"

Zhang Chang looked at Lin Xi and said, "I feel like my strength has become much stronger. Now I feel like I can kill a cow with one punch." Zhang Chang gestured as he spoke.

Lin Xi smiled and said: "It's not that exaggerated. You are at most stronger than normal people now. Is there anything else besides getting stronger?"

Zhang Chang shook his head and said: "It seems that there are no more." Lin Xi was surprised and thought to himself: "It is rare for those who awaken with pure power. The system should give them tasks."
